summary: The PR fixes a regression in pytest 5.4.2, but introduces a new function without proper documentation and may have behavioral regression risks.

issues.description: The change may break existing/untested behavior when using --pdb with skipped tests.
The new function _is_skipped is not documented.
There are no tests for the new function _is_skipped.
The approach of introducing a new function may be considered fragile or not the best abstraction.
